recognition.summary: The program publishes acknowledgments; reporters may decline public credit.

reporting.summary: Synology provides its own reporting form, accepting English and Traditional or Simplified Chinese.

rewards.summary: Rewards are assessed individually; some low-severity contributions receive acknowledgment only.

limitations: First valid, previously unknown reports and coordinated disclosure are required for reward consideration.
Published reward limits are maxima rather than guaranteed payouts.
